info.name: Camila's Lost Letter
info.parent: Looking for the Korean Folk Town...

descriptions.notStarted: Apparently, Camila of Henesys lost something...
descriptions.inProgress: She was devastated that her friend, who lives far from here, sent her a letter, only to be stolen by the notorious Curse Eye's. She was crying as she asked me for help. I may have to find the letter for the sake of Camila, but where is that girl?\n\n#t4031239# #b#c4031239##k/1
descriptions.completed: I recovered Camila's letter that had been stolen from the Curse Eye's. It should be fun writing letters to people far from me...
